subject: Usage & ROI review ahead of renewal — recommended term and capacity options
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@aureliasystems.com>, Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@aureliasystems.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 usage + ROI snapshot — renewal planning

Hi Elena / Marcus,

Thanks again for the time last month. I ran the Q2 usage export and attached a short CSV that summarizes token spend, per-route latency, and the three highest-cost prompts that drove the majority of consumption. Quick highlights:

- Total token spend (Q2): 24.1M tokens (avg 264k tokens/day); up 62% QoQ.
- Top prompt category (chat_summary): ~48% of tokens; median latency 210ms for generation path.
- Aggregate monthly cost (hosted): ~$14.6k/month; predicted run-rate if trends continue: ~$22k/month by Oct.

We know your renewal is due 2028-08-15. Before we propose formal options, the internal team and I sketched three paths:

1) Term extension (12 mo) + 10% committed uplift — keeps you on hosted, adds a 10% discount and 2x burst credits for peak campaigns.
2) Dedicated entry (reserved vCPU/GPU pool) — targeted at sustained throughput (projected 120k tokens/min peak). Lower unit cost, adds a 30% reduction in per-token compute cost but requires a 3-month migration runway.
3) Hybrid: Keep core on hosted, move inference-heavy batch jobs to a small Dedicated pool during peak hours.

I've attached the Q2 export and a workbook with modeled spend for each option (redwood_renewal_options_v2.xlsx). Can you confirm availability for a 30-minute sync this week? Ben will join to talk pricing levers; Marissa will cover perf and migration risks.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Q2 usage + ROI snapshot — renewal planning

Hi Priya,

Thanks for this — the export is super helpful. A few immediate notes from our side:

- The growth was driven by increased use of the chat_summary flow after we rolled it out to two additional product lines (June 5). Good signal, but also a cost risk.
- We saw a small uptick in 99th percentile latency last week during the advertising spike — attached is a screenshot from our monitoring for context (latency_trace_20280629.png).

We'd like to see the detailed model for the Dedicated option because if unit cost drops ~30% like you note, that could be compelling. Our procurement deadline for locking terms is 2028-08-01.

Availability for a sync: Tue 2028-07-03 10:00 AM PT works for Marcus and me.

—Elena

Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 usage + ROI snapshot — renewal planning

Elena — thanks for the quick reply. A couple of numbers to add context before our call:

- Current blended unit cost (hosted, mixed models): ~$0.00061 per token.
- If we move chat_summary to a Dedicated 4-GPU pool (mixed A100 config), modeled unit cost drops to ~$0.00042/token due to better batching and local KV cache hit rates. That assumes your peak concurrency profile stays similar to the last two weeks; I modeled a 20% headroom.
- We can structure a 12-month committed plan with a ramp: 50% reserved the first 2 months, 75% after month 3, plus usage-based burst credits. This reduces your cash outlay during migration.

I attached a simplified pricing slice in the workbook and a short note on migration steps. On migration risk: Marissa — could you summarize typical latency delta we see in the first 30 days post-cutover and any reliability caveats?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben...@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0368

Attachment: redwood_renewal_options_v2.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@aureliasystems.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 06:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 usage + ROI snapshot — renewal planning

Hi all — quick technical note ahead of the call:

- Typical latency: Hosted path median 180–220ms; Dedicated baseline after tuning 120–160ms for same model and batch sizes. 99th percentile improves similarly but depends on QPS spikes and batching efficiency.
- KV cache warm-up: Expect a 24–72 hour period to reach steady cache hit rates for conversational flows; during that window we recommend a brief overlap period where both environments run in parallel for critical routes.
- Ops considerations: We'll need your SRE to open a maintenance window for the cutover; data retention and logging configuration will remain consistent with your current setup.

I'll bring a short migration checklist to the call (replication, prefix preservation, tracing hooks).

—Marissa
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@aureliasystems.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 usage + ROI snapshot — renewal planning

Thanks — that all sounds reasonable. Marcus and I reviewed the workbook and we're leaning toward the Hybrid option as a near-term step: move chat_summary to a Dedicated pool and keep lower-volume routes on hosted.

Two asks before we sign anything:

1) Can Redwood share a short SLA addendum for the Dedicated pool (latency targets and remediation steps) we can include in the order?
2) Can you draft a migration runbook with timeline and key owner actions — we need that for our internal approvals (security and SRE).

We'll be on the Tue 10:00 AM PT call to finalize scope for a PO.

Elena
